comparison.objective: Remove rack from a gantry beam and pull both ends to alignment marks.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate forces at both ends of a long constrained beam to square and translate it.
comparison.success_condition: Beam squared and both ends brought to their marks; tolerances are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Large-object bimanual alignment and unjamming differ from narrow-tool stabilization, impulsive fracture, coil retention, and free-fragment recovery.
